latest_cos_commentary.headline: Revmo AI is a Phoenix-based voice/text/email AI automation vendor for restaurants that won a full chain-wide rollout with Donatos Pizza (174 locations) in 2025, displacing DoorDash's AI phone-ordering product.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes with Genius's kitchen_drive_thru and digital ordering/engagement surfaces on AI-driven phone/voice order capture rather than core POS or payments processing; integrates with existing POS/CRM systems rather than replacing them.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Displaced an incumbent (DoorDash AI) in a named multi-unit account after a competitive evaluation against SoundHound and Kea, indicating active competitive displacement activity in the voice-AI ordering category.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect is evaluating AI phone/voice ordering, note that Revmo positions itself as integrating with existing POS/CRM rather than replacing it — confirm whether any proposed integration touches Genius's POS or payment flow before treating it as a full platform threat.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Public evidence is limited to a single named deal (Donatos); do not extrapolate market share or reliability claims to other accounts without separate verification.
